jobs.description: Hey, wir sind Sunlab – schön, dass du vorbeischaust. Du bist Entwickler aus Leidenschaft schreibst keine Zeile Code mehr per Hand? Du weißt, wie du KI-Tools sinnvoll in Workflows integrierst, komplexe Probleme löst und aus Ideen funktionierende Applikationen machst? Perfekt. Genau danach suchen wir! Wir bei Sunlab verbinden Performance Marketing mit Technologie. Unser Inhouse-Development entwickelt individuelle Tools, intelligente Automatisierungen und technische Lösungen, die Prozesse optimieren und den Arbeitsalltag erleichtern. Dabei verschmilzt die künstliche Intelligenz mit unserer DNA. Ob im Terminal oder OpenCode, Visual Studio Code, etc., unser Stack basiert aktuell auf Claude, OpenAI und einer lokalen LLM (Nvidia Spark). Um unsere Mission weiter voranzubringen, suchen wir dich als AI Software Developer (m/w/d). Dein Verantwortungsbereich Agentic Coding: Du setzt LLMs ein um hochwertigen Code effizient zu entwickeln, bestehende Anwendungen zu erweitern und neue Features umzusetzen ohne dabei per Hand Code zu schreiben. Vom Prompt zum Produkt: Du machst aus Anforderungen und Ideen funktionierende Anwendungen. Dabei setzt du KI gezielt für Architektur, Implementierung, Debugging, Refactoring und Testing ein. Intelligente Automatisierung: Du identifizierst Prozesse, die sich mit KI und Code automatisieren lassen, und entwickelst dafür pragmatische, skalierbare Lösungen. KI-Integration: Du integrierst LLMs und passende APIs in bestehende Systeme und entwickelst beispielsweise intelligente Assistenten, datengetriebene Tools oder automatisierte Workflows. Qualität statt blindem Vertrauen: Du überprüfst KI-generierten Code, erkennst Schwachstellen und stellst sicher, dass deine Lösungen performant, wartbar und sicher sind. Tech-Stack weiterdenken: Du testest neue KI-Tools und Entwicklungsansätze, bewertest ihren praktischen Nutzen und bringst die besten Lösungen in unseren Arbeitsalltag. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works. Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Nous accompagnons des organisations de toutes tailles dans la structuration et le pilotage de leurs enjeux de conformité, avec une ambition : rendre des sujets complexes plus simples, accessibles et opérationnels. Dans un contexte de croissance et de développement à l'international, nous renforçons notre organisation commerciale et recrutons notre PreSales Engineer pour accompagner nos opportunités stratégiques. Ton rôle chez Dastra À la croisée du business, de la technologie et du conseil, tu joueras un rôle clé dans nos cycles de vente complexes. Ta mission : apporter la crédibilité et les preuves techniques qui feront de Dastra la solution de référence pour nos futurs clients. En véritable partenaire de nos équipes Sales, tu interviendras sur les opportunités stratégiques pour comprendre les enjeux techniques des prospects, démontrer la pertinence de notre plateforme et sécuriser leur décision. Tes missions Qualifier les besoins techniques : conduire les phases de Technical Discovery , analyser les environnements IT des prospects et échanger avec leurs interlocuteurs techniques (DSI, RSSI, équipes IT), en complément de la qualification business réalisée par les Sales. Démontrer la valeur de Dastra : concevoir des environnements de démonstration personnalisés, construire des cas d'usage pertinents et animer des démonstrations adaptées aux enjeux métiers et techniques des clients. Piloter les Proof of Concept (POC) : définir les critères de succès, organiser les validations techniques et apporter les preuves concrètes de l'adéquation de notre solution aux besoins du client. Sécuriser les cycles de vente complexes : répondre aux questions d'architecture, d'intégration, de sécurité et de configuration (SSO, API, interconnexions, MCP...) et lever les objections techniques des prospects. In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D , at a valuation of $1.3B. The opportunity in DACH for TULIP DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value. TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP's headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. jobs.description: About Agent F Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention. Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control. We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work. About the role You will sit exactly where sales, customer success and engineering meet. When a larger customer signs, you make sure they get precisely the product they need, and that it goes live. You understand their finance and operations setup, configure and extend Agent F for it, drive the data migration and the integrations, run the project to go-live and stay until the expansion works. This is operational work inside customer projects. You will be the technical counterpart for the customer’s finance, IT and operations teams, the person who knows what was promised and what is possible, and the one who brings back to engineering (as clear, prioritised requirements) whatever cannot be solved on site. On key accounts the CEO is in the room and the whole team pulls through together. Our north star is live ARR: how many companies have signed, gone live, are satisfied and have started paying, and from there, how many stay and grow with us. Every commercial role at Agent F is measured against that chain. For you, that means time to live and the ARR of the accounts you bring live. What you will build and own Implementation projects. jobs.title: Integrations Engineer
jobs.description: What Makes Cloudbeds Unique At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started. How You'll Make an Impact: Thailand is one of Cloudbeds’ largest and most important markets, and Thai hoteliers run on an integration stack most of the world never sees. Hundreds of our largest Thai properties depend on these connections every day, and when one breaks, a front desk agent stops being a host and servicing guests. As our Integrations Developer in Thailand, you’ll be the engineer who makes that stack reliable. You’ll work hand in hand with our long-standing local integration partner, MecX Tech, and with Cloudbeds’ Integrations Product and Engineering teams, to diagnose and fix integration issues at the code level, harden the integrations our customers rely on most, and design and build new integrations for the Thai market. This is a hands-on build role with a customer-facing edge. You’ll own the hardest technical escalations, ship the fixes, and then build the tooling, monitoring and documentation that stop the same problem from coming back. You’ll champion our AI Smarts + Hospitality Hearts mission by using AI-assisted development and automation to move fast, so more of your time goes to the problems that genuinely need an engineer. Our Integrations Team

jobs.description: About Notabene Notabene is on a mission to make crypto a part of the everyday economy. Leading crypto organizations use our tools to reduce transaction risk and make crypto transfers safe. Working across three continents in eight countries, the Notabene team serves our fantastic community of 100+ customers, including financial institutions, fintechs, exchanges, and more. Our co-founders spearheaded foundational Self Sovereign Identity protocols and use-cases. This technology is key to the internals of our cutting edge tech stack. We’re proud to have the support of leading investors, including Y Combinator, Jump Capital, Castle Island, Green Visor Capital, and more. We’re at an exhilarating moment in our journey, as regulation technologies (reg-techs) are fast becoming recognized as a vital enabler of the crypto ecosystem. Notabene is growing fast—and we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry! The Impact You'll Have: Every crypto transfer we touch moves between institutions that run their own systems, answer to different regulators, and have no reason to trust each other. The software in the middle has to be right every time. A message processed twice, a lost update, or a record shown to the wrong tenant is a compliance failure for our customers. You’ll work on the core platform that carries this data between institutions around the world, written in Go. As a Staff Engineer on the team you’ll build the hardest parts of it, contribute to its design, and help the engineers around you do their best work. What You'll Do Design and build core parts of our transaction platform. Build for correctness under failure, with the isolation and auditability a regulated product needs. Scale the platform as transaction volume and the number of institutions per node grow, keeping latency predictable and the database healthy. A strong foundation in systems programming: concurrency, memory and resource management, networking and performance tuning.

jobs.description: Join a fast-growing, listed company with a purpose! Fastned owns and operates a network of 400+ fast charging stations across 10 European countries, allowing electric vehicle drivers to charge their car with 100% green energy in just 15 minutes. Our goal is a European network of 1000 fast charging stations in prime locations, where all electric vehicles can charge with renewable energy from the sun and wind. We have recently been voted best charging network in the UK, France and the Netherlands. If you want to make a difference and work in an informal, international scale-up environment with future prospects, then read on! Your role Fastned aims to accelerate the transition towards sustainable mobility by giving fast charging to electric drivers. Part of that mission is making car charging as simple as charging your phone, and paying for it should be just as effortless. As a Backend Engineer in the Payments team, you will help make paying for a charge frictionless, secure and reliable. Drivers can pay through the Fastned app, by QR code or with a contactless card at the charger. The team owns Fastned’s payments domain end to end. That covers integrations with payment service providers and payment terminals. It also covers the services behind payment methods, wallets, pre-authorisation and session payments, billing, invoicing and dunning. The stakes are high: Fastned handles 23,000+ charging sessions a day, and every one of those payments goes through our systems. We’re now moving towards real-time payments, where each session is paid instantly instead of invoiced later. As we are growing and adding roaming features as a Mobility Service Provider, there are many scale relevant challenges to solve. We have no legacy systems. You’ll work with Kotlin 2.x, Java 21+, and Spring Boot 4 on most services, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, SQL (Postgres), Terraform, GitLab CI/CD and REST APIs to build scalable, fault-tolerant services that drivers and our Finance team rely on every day

Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise. The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time. Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect! About the Role As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions. You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality. jobs.description: Your Opportunity As a Principal Engineer , you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs. You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.
